title: Paperless Underway — synthetic offline packet workflow
description: Dependency-free local application for both forms and tasking tracks. Local inbox routing and two-replica reconnect are explicitly simulated; no operational systems contacted.

components.label: Source capture and extraction review
components.description: Synthetic handwritten image, requisition, correspondence and week tasking; cited candidates and corrections.

components.label: Packet rules and named outputs
components.description: Deterministic synthetic extraction, validation, filing, accuracy and six named outputs; no model authority.

components.label: Human review and local routing
components.description: Exact-revision approval, visible local recipient inboxes and idempotent routing.

components.label: Durable offline workspace
components.description: IndexedDB transactions for sources, drafts, immutable revisions, approvals, audit, queue and acknowledged bytes.

components.label: Simulated reconnect and transfer
components.description: Two local replicas; explicit conflict review, merge order independence and acknowledged bounded transfer. No network adapter.

components.label: Packet exports and evidence
components.description: Named outputs, source/audit export, invented metrics, assessment placeholders and one-page transition plan.
